text: …　ポチッとな　でんどうドアの　だい１　ロックが　はずれた！

structure.jp: でんどうドアの　だい１　ロックが
structure.en: the first lock on the electric door

patterns.name: 〜と (how)
patterns.explanation: と after a sound word tells you the way something is done, here the sound of the button press. The な after it is just a playful ending. ポチッとな = 'with a click!'.
